blocks.text: **some** va **any** aniq aytilmagan miqdorni bildiradi: bir nechta, biroz, ozgina. Ular ko'plikdagi sanaladigan otlar (apples, friends) va sanalmaydigan otlar (bread, money, time) bilan ishlatiladi. O'zbek tilida bunday so'z ko'pincha umuman aytilmaydi: «Non oldim» — I bought **some** bread; «Pulim yo'q» — I haven't got **any** money; «Savollaringiz bormi?» — Have you got **any** questions? Shuning uchun o'zbeklar ularni tez-tez tushirib qoldiradi yoki adashtiradi.

Nega shunday? **some** — narsa **bor**, faqat miqdori aytilmagan. **any** — narsa bor-yo'qligi **noma'lum** (savol) yoki u **yo'q** (inkor). Birlikdagi sanaladigan ot bilan some/any ishlatilmaydi: «some apple» emas — **an** apple yoki **some** apples (65, 67–68-darslar).
Darak gapda **some** ishlatiladi. Tarjimada u «bir nechta», «biroz», «ozgina», «bir qancha» bo'lishi yoki umuman tushib qolishi mumkin.

items.text: We need **some** new curtains for the bedroom.
I'd like to ask you **some** questions.

blocks.text: Inkor gapda (not, n't bilan) — **any**: I do**n't** have **any** money. O'zbekchada bu yerda «hech qanday», «birorta ham», «umuman» yoki shunchaki «yo'q» deyiladi. Savolda ham — **any**: Are there **any** ...? O'zbekchada savolda alohida so'z bo'lmaydi: «...bormi?». Diqqat: inglizchada **inkor faqat bitta** — not + any. «I haven't got no money» deyilmaydi (77–78-darslar).

items.text: There aren't **any** clean glasses in the cupboard.
Sorry, I didn't buy **any** milk today.
Are there **any** good shops near your flat?

blocks.text: Taklif (Would you like ...?) va iltimos (Can I have ...? Could you give me ...?) — savol bo'lsa ham, **some** bilan aytiladi, chunki bunda «ha» javobini kutamiz. «Would you like any tea?» deyilsa, xuddi «choy ichmasangiz kerak-a?» degandek eshitiladi.

items.text: Would you like **some** fresh bread with your soup?
Could I have **some** sugar for my tea, please?
Can you lend me **some** money for the bus?

blocks.text: Otsiz: I've got some. There isn't any.
Ot oldin aytilgan bo'lsa, **some** va **any** otsiz, yolg'iz ishlatiladi — xuddi o'zbekchadagi «bor» / «yo'q» kabi. Savol-javobda ayniqsa ko'p uchraydi:

Xuddi shu qoida **something / anything**, **somebody / anybody** so'zlariga ham tegishli (I saw **something**. — I didn't see **anything**.) → 78–79-darslar. **no** va **none** → 77-dars, **some of / any of** → 81-dars.

O'zbeklarning tipik xatolari: «I haven't got some money.» → **I haven't got any money.**; «Do you have some brothers?» (oddiy savol) → **Do you have any brothers?**; «Would you like any tea?» (taklif) → **Would you like some tea?**; «I want some apple.» → **I want an apple.** yoki **some apples**; «I don't have no time.» → **I don't have any time.** (inglizchada ikki inkor bo'lmaydi).
Eslab qolish: **some** — narsa **bor** (darak). **any** — narsa **yo'q** yoki bor-yo'qligi **noma'lum** (inkor, savol). Taklif qilyapsizmi yoki iltimos qilyapsizmi — «ha»ni kutasiz, demak **some**.

items: **some** / **any** — ko'plikdagi sanaladigan va sanalmaydigan otlar bilan: some books, any water;
darak gapda — **some**: There are **some** letters for you.
inkor gapda — **any** (bitta inkor!): I don't need **any** help.
taklif va iltimosda — **some**: Would you like **some** cake? Can I have **some** water?
otsiz ham: I've got **some**. / There isn't **any**.

examples.title: **some** in positive sentences
examples.description: Darak gapda **some**: ko'plikdagi sanaladigan ot bilan (some letters — bir nechta xat) va sanalmaydigan ot bilan (some help — biroz yordam). O'zbekchada ko'pincha tarjima qilinmaydi.

sentences.text: I bought **some** bread and cheese for breakfast.
sentences.translation: Nonushtaga **biroz** non va pishloq oldim.

sentences.text: There are **some** letters for you on the table.
sentences.translation: Stol ustida sizga **bir nechta** xat bor.

sentences.text: We met **some** interesting people in Samarkand.
sentences.translation: Samarqandda **bir qancha** qiziqarli odamlar bilan tanishdik.

sentences.text: Aziz needs **some** help with his homework.
sentences.translation: Azizga uy vazifasida **biroz** yordam kerak.

sentences.text: Put **some** salt in the water before you add the pasta.
sentences.translation: Makaronni solishdan oldin suvga **ozgina** tuz soling.

sentences.text: **Some** friends from university are coming to dinner tonight.
sentences.translation: Bugun kechqurun universitetdagi **bir nechta** do'stim kechki ovqatga kelyapti.

sentences.text: Emma has got **some** good news for you.
sentences.translation: Emmada siz uchun **bir** yaxshi xabar bor.

sentences.text: I'd like to spend **some** time in the mountains this summer.
sentences.translation: Shu yozda tog'larda **biroz** vaqt o'tkazmoqchiman.

sentences.text: My grandmother gave me **some** money for my birthday, and I bought a book with it.
sentences.translation: Buvim tug'ilgan kunimga **biroz** pul berdi, men unga kitob sotib oldim.

sentences.text: It's cold outside, so take **some** warm clothes with you.
sentences.translation: Tashqarida sovuq, o'zingiz bilan **bir-ikkita** issiq kiyim oling.

examples.title: Negative: **not** ... **any**
examples.description: Inkor gapda **any**: I haven't got **any** change. O'zbekchada — «hech qanday», «birorta ham», «umuman» yoki shunchaki «yo'q». Inkor faqat bitta: not + any.

sentences.text: Sorry, I haven't got **any** coins for the parking machine.
sentences.translation: Kechirasiz, menda to'lov apparati uchun **birorta ham** tanga **yo'q**.

sentences.text: There aren't **any** buses after midnight.
sentences.translation: Yarim tundan keyin **hech qanday** avtobus yo'q.

sentences.text: We didn't buy **any** souvenirs in Bukhara.
sentences.translation: Buxorodan **hech qanday** esdalik sovg'a olmadik.

sentences.text: Bekzod doesn't eat **any** meat — he's a vegetarian.
sentences.translation: Bekzod go'shtni **umuman** yemaydi — u vegetarian.

sentences.text: This soup isn't very good — there isn't **any** salt in it.
sentences.translation: Bu sho'rva unchalik mazali emas — unda **umuman** tuz yo'q.

sentences.text: I'm afraid we haven't got **any** rooms for tonight.
sentences.translation: Afsuski, bugun kechaga **birorta ham** bo'sh xonamiz yo'q.

sentences.text: Madina can't make the cake because she hasn't got **any** eggs.
sentences.translation: Madina tort pishira olmaydi, chunki uyida **tuxum qolmagan**.

sentences.text: They didn't have **any** problems at the border.
sentences.translation: Chegarada ular **hech qanday** muammoga duch kelishmadi.

sentences.text: The children didn't make **any** noise, so we slept well.
sentences.translation: Bolalar **umuman** shovqin qilishmadi, shuning uchun yaxshi uxladik.

sentences.text: My phone isn't working — I can't send **any** messages.
sentences.translation: Telefonim ishlamayapti — **hech qanday** xabar jo'nata olmayapman.

examples.title: Questions: Have you got **any** ...?
examples.description: Savolda **any**: Have you got **any** brothers? Are there **any** ...? O'zbekchada odatda alohida so'z yo'q: «Aka-ukangiz bormi?»

sentences.text: Have you got **any** brothers or sisters? — Yes, two sisters.
sentences.translation: Aka-uka, opa-singillaringiz **bormi**? — Ha, ikkita singlim bor.

sentences.text: Are there **any** good restaurants near your hotel?
sentences.translation: Mehmonxonangiz yaqinida yaxshi restoranlar **bormi**?

sentences.text: Did you take **any** photos at the wedding?
sentences.translation: To'yda **biror** surat oldingizmi?

sentences.text: Is there **any** milk in the fridge? — No, there isn't.
sentences.translation: Muzlatgichda sut **bormi**? — Yo'q, qolmagan.

sentences.text: Do you have **any** questions about the test?
sentences.translation: Test bo'yicha **savollaringiz bormi**?

sentences.text: Has Tom got **any** children? — Yes, two boys.
sentences.translation: Tomning **farzandlari** bormi? — Ha, ikki o'g'li bor.

sentences.text: Do we need **any** bread? — No, there's some in the cupboard.
sentences.translation: Non **kerakmi**? — Yo'q, shkafda bor.

sentences.text: Excuse me, are there **any** free tables outside?
sentences.translation: Kechirasiz, tashqarida **bo'sh stol** bormi?

sentences.text: Were there **any** famous people at the concert?
sentences.translation: Konsertda **biror** mashhur odam bormidi?

sentences.text: Have you read **any** books by this writer?
sentences.translation: Bu yozuvchining **birorta** kitobini o'qiganmisiz?

examples.title: Offers and requests: Would you like **some** ...?
examples.description: Taklif va iltimosda — savol bo'lsa ham — **some**, chunki «ha» javobini kutamiz: Would you like **some** tea? Can I have **some** water?

sentences.text: Would you like **some** more tea, Grandma?
sentences.translation: Buvijon, yana **ozgina** choy quyaymi?

sentences.text: Can I have **some** water, please?
sentences.translation: **Ozgina** suv bersangiz, iltimos.

sentences.text: Could you lend me **some** money until Friday?
sentences.translation: Jumagacha menga **biroz** pul qarz berib tura olasizmi?

sentences.text: Do you want **some** help with those bags?
sentences.translation: Sumkalarni ko'tarishga **yordamlashib yuboraymi**?

sentences.text: Mum, can we have **some** ice cream after dinner?
sentences.translation: Oyi, kechki ovqatdan keyin **muzqaymoq** yesak bo'ladimi?

sentences.text: Shall I bring **some** fruit to the party?
sentences.translation: Ziyofatga **biroz** meva olib kelaymi?

sentences.text: Have **some** cake, Aziz — Madina made it herself.
sentences.translation: **Tortdan** oling, Aziz — uni Madinaning o'zi pishirgan.

sentences.text: Excuse me, could you give me **some** information about trains to Manchester?
sentences.translation: Kechirasiz, Manchesterga boradigan poyezdlar haqida **ma'lumot** bera olasizmi?

sentences.text: Why don't you take **some** sandwiches for the journey?
sentences.translation: Yo'lga **bir nechta** sendvich olib olmaysizmi?

sentences.text: I've made a big pot of soup — would you like **some**?
sentences.translation: Katta qozonda sho'rva pishirdim — **ozgina** quyib beraymi?

examples.title: Without a noun: I've got **some**. There isn't **any**.
examples.description: Ot oldin aytilgan bo'lsa, **some** va **any** otsiz ham keladi — o'zbekcha «bor» / «yo'q» kabi: I need stamps. — I've got **some**.

sentences.text: I need some stamps. — Oh, I've got **some** in my bag.
sentences.translation: Menga marka kerak. — Oh, sumkamda **bor**.

sentences.text: We wanted to buy strawberries, but the market didn't have **any**.
sentences.translation: Qulupnay olmoqchi edik, lekin bozorda **yo'q ekan**.

sentences.text: Need paper? There's **some** in the printer.
sentences.translation: Qog'oz kerakmi? Printerda **bor**.

sentences.text: These biscuits are delicious — do try **some**!
sentences.translation: Bu pechenyelar juda mazali — **bir-ikkitasini** tatib ko'ring!

sentences.text: Sarah wanted to borrow a novel, but I didn't have **any** in English.
sentences.translation: Sara roman so'radi, lekin menda inglizchasi **yo'q edi**.

sentences.text: Is there any coffee? — Sorry, there isn't **any** left.
sentences.translation: Qahva bormi? — Kechirasiz, **qolmabdi**.

sentences.text: Aziz picked apricots in his garden and gave us **some**.
sentences.translation: Aziz bog'idan o'rik terdi va bizga **biroz** berdi.

sentences.text: I looked for mistakes in your essay, but I didn't find **any**.
sentences.translation: Inshongizdan xato qidirdim, lekin **birorta ham** topmadim.

sentences.text: Emma loves chocolate, but she can't eat **any** because of her allergy.
sentences.translation: Emma shokoladni yaxshi ko'radi, lekin allergiyasi tufayli **umuman** yeya olmaydi.

sentences.text: Have we got eggs for the omelette? — Yes, there are **some** in the fridge.
sentences.translation: Omlet uchun tuxum bormi? — Ha, muzlatgichda **bor**.

examples.title: **some** ..., but not **any** ...
examples.description: Tasdiq va inkor yonma-yon: bir narsa bor (**some**), boshqasi yo'q (**not any**). There's **some** rice, but there aren't **any** onions.

sentences.text: I've got **some** euros, but I haven't got **any** pounds.
sentences.translation: Menda **biroz** yevro bor, lekin funt **yo'q**.

sentences.text: There's **some** rice in the cupboard, but there aren't **any** onions.
sentences.translation: Shkafda **biroz** guruch bor, lekin piyoz **umuman yo'q**.

sentences.text: Tom has **some** friends in London, but he hasn't got **any** in Oxford.
sentences.translation: Tomning Londonda **bir nechta** do'sti bor, Oksfordda esa **birortasi ham yo'q**.

sentences.text: We saw **some** deer in the forest, but we didn't see **any** bears.
sentences.translation: O'rmonda **bir nechta** bug'u ko'rdik, lekin **birorta ham** ayiq ko'rmadik.

sentences.text: The hotel has **some** nice rooms with a view, but it doesn't have **any** parking.
sentences.translation: Mehmonxonada manzarali **bir nechta** yaxshi xona bor, lekin **hech qanday** avtoturargoh yo'q.

sentences.text: Dilnoza made **some** mistakes in the first test, but she didn't make **any** in the second.
sentences.translation: Dilnoza birinchi testda **bir nechta** xato qildi, ikkinchisida esa **birorta ham** xato qilmadi.

sentences.text: Our village has **some** small shops, but there aren't **any** cafés.
sentences.translation: Qishlog'imizda **bir nechta** kichik do'kon bor, lekin kafe **umuman yo'q**.

sentences.text: Bekzod speaks **some** German, but he doesn't speak **any** French.
sentences.translation: Bekzod nemischani **biroz** biladi, frantsuzchani esa **umuman** bilmaydi.

sentences.text: In the morning there were **some** clouds, but in the afternoon there weren't **any**.
sentences.translation: Ertalab **biroz** bulut bor edi, tushdan keyin esa **umuman** qolmadi.

sentences.text: My parents grow **some** vegetables in their garden, but they don't use **any** chemicals.
sentences.translation: Ota-onam tomorqasida **biroz** sabzavot yetishtiradi, lekin **hech qanday** kimyoviy dori ishlatmaydi.

examples.title: Cooking plov: Have we got **any** rice?
examples.description: Kundalik suhbat: savolda **any**, javobda **some** yoki **not any**, iltimos va taklifda **some**.

sentences.text: — Let's make plov tonight. Have we got **any** rice?
sentences.translation: — Bugun kechqurun palov qilaylik. Guruch **bormi**?

sentences.text: — Yes, there's **some** in the cupboard, about two kilos.
sentences.translation: — Ha, shkafda **bor**, ikki kilocha.

sentences.text: — Good. And are there **any** carrots?
sentences.translation: — Yaxshi. Sabzi-chi, **bormi**?

sentences.text: — No, there aren't **any**. I used the last ones yesterday.
sentences.translation: — Yo'q, **qolmagan**. Oxirgilarini kecha ishlatdim.

sentences.text: — Then I need to buy **some**. What about meat?
sentences.translation: — Unda **biroz** sotib olishim kerak. Go'sht-chi?

sentences.text: — There's **some** lamb in the freezer.
sentences.translation: — Muzlatkichda **biroz** qo'y go'shti bor.

sentences.text: — Great. Do we need **any** onions too?
sentences.translation: — Zo'r. Piyoz ham **kerakmi**?

sentences.text: — No, we've got **some**. But could you buy **some** bread?
sentences.translation: — Yo'q, piyoz **bor**. Lekin **non** olib kela olasizmi?

sentences.text: — Of course. Shall I get **some** tomatoes for a salad as well?
sentences.translation: — Albatta. Salat uchun **biroz** pomidor ham olaymi?

sentences.text: — Yes, please. And don't spend **any** money on sweets!
sentences.translation: — Ha, iltimos. Faqat shirinlikka **umuman** pul sarflamang!

examples.title: Mixed practice: **some** or **any**?
examples.description: Aralash mustahkamlash: darak, taklif va iltimosda **some**; inkor va savolda **any**; otsiz shakllar.

sentences.text: Are there **any** museums in this town? — Yes, there are **some** near the main square.
sentences.translation: Bu shaharda muzeylar **bormi**? — Ha, bosh maydon yaqinida **bir nechtasi** bor.

sentences.text: I'm sorry, I can't help you — I haven't got **any** experience with computers.
sentences.translation: Kechirasiz, yordam bera olmayman — kompyuter bo'yicha **hech qanday** tajribam yo'q.

sentences.text: Would you like **some** grapes? They're from our garden.
sentences.translation: **Ozgina** uzum yeysizmi? O'zimizning bog'dan.

sentences.text: Did you buy **any** fruit at the market? — Yes, I bought **some** peaches.
sentences.translation: Bozordan meva **oldingizmi**? — Ha, **bir nechta** shaftoli oldim.

sentences.text: James has **some** relatives in Scotland, but he doesn't visit them often.
sentences.translation: Jeymsning Shotlandiyada **bir nechta** qarindoshi bor, lekin u ularnikiga tez-tez bormaydi.

sentences.text: Can you give me **some** advice about buying a car?
sentences.translation: Mashina olish bo'yicha **biroz** maslahat bera olasizmi?

sentences.text: There isn't **any** sugar in my tea — could you pass me **some**?
sentences.translation: Choyimda shakar **yo'q** — **ozgina** uzatib yuborasizmi?

sentences.text: Madina didn't have **any** lessons today, so she spent **some** time in the library.
sentences.translation: Bugun Madinaning **birorta ham** darsi yo'q edi, shuning uchun u kutubxonada **biroz** vaqt o'tkazdi.

sentences.text: Has your brother found **any** work in London yet?
sentences.translation: Akangiz Londonda **biror** ish topdimi?

sentences.text: When I opened the fridge, there wasn't **any** food — only **some** old cheese.
sentences.translation: Muzlatgichni ochsam, ichida **hech qanday** ovqat yo'q — faqat **biroz** eski pishloq bor ekan.
